title: Genome-wide CRISPR screening to identify pathways supporting survival under impaired mitochondrial protein synthesis
core_idea: Use genome-wide CRISPR/Cas9 knockout screening combined with pharmacological targeting of mitochondrial ribosomes to identify genes and pathways that modulate cell fitness and mitochondrial quality control when mitochondrial protein synthesis is disrupted.
tldr: Combine CRISPR screening with mitoribosome inhibitors to map genetic suppressors and adaptive pathways that help cells cope with impaired mitochondrial translation.
